method: Independent JSONL/Parquet float64 arithmetic; sum squared errors/N then sqrt, absolute error sum/N, TimeNLL sum/N; mean=fsum(seed metrics)/3, sample SD=sqrt(fsum((x-mean)^2)/2). No evaluator/comparator helpers imported.
limitations: External Validation18 has no saved individual predictions; six metrics reconciled to original selected endpoint aggregates and three overall metrics to selected-epoch history.
Final Markdown renders TimeNLL with six decimal places; very small positive values can display as 0.000000. Full values and seed differences remain in JSON.
This validates local arithmetic and displayed rows only. It does not establish an independent new evaluation, significance, causation or final training convergence.
